$comment: The updater's configuration, in one file, because it is the one thing in the
release that cannot be fixed after the fact: an app installed with the wrong
public key can never be updated again, and there is no way to reach those
`plugins.updater` in tauri.conf.json must match this file exactly.
scripts/check_updater_config.py is that comparison and the release workflow's
preflight runs it, so the two cannot drift.
The public key is a config value and ships inside the app. The private key
never enters this repository in any form: it is read from the signing
environment under the secret NAME below, which is unset here.
Building a release does not deliver it. release-desktop.yml produces
artifacts; release-desktop-promote.yml is the human step that writes
latest.json, and a pre-release never moves it (docs/RELEASE.md §4).
Rollback is therefore editing one JSON file, not un-shipping a build.
